title: Move text pipeline onto artifact model

context.summary: Persist extracted text and text chunks as derived artifacts with source refs while keeping existing chunk/index APIs working.
context.background: TASK-38 added the derived artifact schema, TASK-39 added routing and TASK-40 added recompute runs. The existing text path still wrote only legacy extracted text objects, chunks and pgvector rows.

in: Create text processing runs for ordinary upload processing when recompute has not supplied one.
Write extracted text as a document_artifacts text artifact plus an extracted_text span.
Write each text chunk as a child text artifact plus a text_chunk span.
Preserve legacy chunks rows and pgvector indexing as compatibility/search projections.
Propagate processing_run_id, artifact ids and source_refs into chunk and vector metadata.
Add full-text search over document_artifact_text_spans, excluding superseded processing runs.
Add a forward migration for the text span full-text GIN index.
Update integration tests, validators and documentation.
out: Store embeddings in document_artifact_vectors instead of chunk_vector_embeddings.
Expose artifact list/search APIs beyond existing document search.

acceptance_criteria: Text extraction creates or reuses a processing_run and writes a text artifact.
Chunking creates child text artifacts and text_chunk spans with source offsets.
Legacy chunk rows include artifact/source-ref metadata so existing context and vector paths keep working.
Document fallback search uses PostgreSQL full-text search over artifact text spans.
Search excludes spans attached to superseded processing runs.
Semantic search hits include artifact source refs when vectors are enabled.
The RAW original storage object remains unchanged.
A migration adds the full-text search index without changing 0000_initial_schema.

manual_checks: Confirm search results include artifact source refs.

risks: The task keeps legacy chunks and chunk_vector_embeddings as projections; a later task can move vectors to document_artifact_vectors.
PostgreSQL full-text search uses the simple configuration for MVP portability.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
